A team-aware auth manager distinguishes a team-scoped Dag from a global one by that field -- the Keycloak auth manager, for example, checks the `DAG` resource instead of `DAG:<team>` -- so the team-scoped permission that should gate the request was never consulted. In a deployment running multi-team mode with a team-aware auth manager, an authenticated user in one team could trigger Dag runs belonging to another team, supplying their own `dag_run_id` and `conf`, and could read another team's XCom values. Deployments using the FAB auth manager are unaffected, as it has no multi-team support. Users are advised to upgrade to apache-airflow 3.3.1 or later, which resolves the Dag's team at both sites.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00589, "percentile": 0.45801}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-5247-m8w9-2v4m", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-02T23:16:02Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5247-m8w9-2v4m", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-5247-m8w9-2v4m"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-68971"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-08-12T16:17:19Z", "published_at": "2026-08-12T18:31:19Z", "references": ["https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-68971", "https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/70893", "https://lists.apache.org/thread/kfxqqwgojdjdnt6bxg3ord4y41y334fo", "http://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2026/08/12/15", "https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/0940c4b66c270d929e9f59914c65e15bd4734680", "https://github.com/apache/airflow/commit/f81459835adb111e57b2a87f586d856395660f8a", "https://github.com/apache/airflow/releases/tag/3.3.1", "https://github.com/pypa/advisory-database/tree/main/vulns/apache-airflow/PYSEC-2026-3994.yaml", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5247-m8w9-2v4m"], "repository_advisory_url": null, "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/apache/airflow", "summary": "Apache Airflow missing team context permits cross-team Dag actions and XCom reads", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-02T23:17:28Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-5247-m8w9-2v4m", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "3.3.1", "package": {"ecosystem": "pip", "name": "apache-airflow"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 3.3.1"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
